blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Transportation Secretary Vince Dizon plans to review the supply of public transportation options against commuter demand, as he looks to address the shortage of available rides before the Christmas rush. Dizon said he would meet with officials of the Land Transportation Office (LTO) and the Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB), along with representatives of public utility vehicle cooperatives, operators, bus companies, motorcycle taxi operators and transport network vehicle services. The discussions would focus on determining whether the current number of public utility vehicles, including buses, public utility jeepneys and motorcycles, is enough to serve commuters. “And we have […]...
